bull.point: Revenue has demonstrated strong long-term compounding growth.
bull.evidence: Revenue compounded 26.9% a year over 3 years.

bull.point: Management expects upward trajectory and margin stability.
bull.evidence: Oct 2026 call: 'trajectory will be upward... neutral to positive on the margin.'

bull.point: Cash flow generation significantly exceeds reported profits recently.
bull.evidence: CFO to PAT ratio was 173.26% in Mar 2025 and 143.28% in Mar 2026.

bear.point: Profit growth is failing to keep pace with revenue expansion.
bear.evidence: Profit grew slower than revenue (19.7% vs 26.9% 3y CAGR).

bear.point: Return on Capital Employed remains at a low single-digit level.
Analysts are concerned about stagnant market share in core deposits.
bear.evidence: Jul 2026 call concerns: 'Branch scaling and flatlining savings account market share'.

watch_next: Margin trajectory following FCNR deposit impacts and cost of funds pressure.
Sustainability of corporate loan growth versus retail growth mix.
Impact of monsoon shortfall on agriculture asset quality.
